summary: Dossier generation: length overruns caused by token-denominated budgets Qwen can't self-count — denominate prompts in words
description:
ROOT CAUSE FOUND for the c12 L1 overrun epidemic (b1c8be4c fix 1 recovered only 6/28; fold path 6d141319 recovered 1/24 — the rest failed even after compression).

EVIDENCE (direct A/B against Qwen3.8-27B on :8080, same input, temp 0.6):
- Prompt: 'summary of exactly 124 tokens (+/-20%)' -> model produced 313+ tokens of content, ~2.5x over. In a truncated run it burned the whole budget INSIDE reasoning_content doing token-count arithmetic ('the acceptable range is 99 to 149 tokens... Let me think about how tokens work') and never emitted content.
- Same prompt rephrased 'at most 90 words' -> 53 words (~70 tokens), comfortably compliant.

The model cannot self-count tokens but handles word budgets fine. Our templates denominate in tokens: l1-v3 says 'Write a summary of {budget} tokens (±20%)'; compress-v1 says 'Compress ... to at most {budget} tokens.' So every budget is systematically overrun ~2-3x, the validator (correctly counting cl100k) rejects, and we built compression/fold machinery to fight a unit mismatch.

Measured ratio on this corpus: 40 staged L1s average 1.41 tokens/word (median 1.39).

FIX: denominate prompt budgets in WORDS, converting at plan/render time: words = round(tokens / 1.4). Sites:
- prompts/dossier/l1-v3.md + l2-v2 + compress-v1: change wording from '{budget} tokens' to '{budget_words} words'
- generate_dossiers.py render calls: pass budget_words = max(60, round(budget / 1.4)) alongside or instead of the token budget; validator keeps counting cl100k tokens (unchanged, it is correct).
- Same treatment for any other prose templates with token-denominated budgets.

EXPECTED EFFECT: overruns should collapse to the genuinely-dense tail; compression retries become rare; fold path rarely triggers. The band itself stays honest because validation is unchanged.

NOTE: this also explains why claude-code did NOT show this failure mode at scale — frontier models estimate their own output length far better. The bug only bites local models hard.

resolution.note: Live prose templates (l1-v3, l2-v2, compress-v1, fold-v1) now state budgets in words; generate_dossiers.budget_words() converts tokens/1.4 at render time with a 60-word floor. Validators still count cl100k tokens — the band is unchanged.
